exercise.title: LA County 2025 Family Reunification Center — public planning records
exercise.scenario: Public planning, evaluation guidance and template. No participant performance observations supplied.

objectives.text: Activate the FIC/FRC plan within 15 minutes of notification.
Identify a family reunification area within 15 minutes of plan activation.
Define the roles and responsibilities of staff assigned to the FIC/FRC area.

terms: Staff was assigned their FIC/FRC role and responsibility

objectives.text: Use the FRC application during FIC/FRC plan activation to support reunification.

terms: FRC end-user successfully logged into the FRC application

exercise.title: Regional Surge and Regional Surge Squared — completed public AAR/IP
exercise.scenario: Published evaluator report for August 1–4, 2017. The record uses the first calendar day as its date-indexing window. The report spans multiple days, and its exercise duration is not scored. No primary observations supplied for independent performance scoring.

objectives.text: Receive and provide care for short-notice inpatient transfers in accordance with hospital surge plans.
Use an incident command or incident management system consistent with NIMS.

B.duration_note: Required API duration is the first calendar day indexing window (1,440 minutes). Source provides the August 1–4 range and no single elapsed duration. Excluded from scoring.
